products.name: Irrigation Zone Map Desk
products.product: A focused irrigation zone map correction workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent irrigation maintenance and repair companies
products.problem: Controller labels, valve locations, plant areas, and field behavior diverge over time, so each technician rediscovers the system differently.
products.valueProposition: Turns irrigation zone map correction into a visible operating queue so every discovered zone discrepancy becomes a verified shared map update with evidence and an effective date.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets irrigation zone map correction software, irrigation zone map correction tracker, irrigation zone map correction template, and irrigation zone map correction checklist searches.

products.name: Seasonal Irrigation Transition
products.product: A focused irrigation startup and winterization tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent irrigation maintenance and repair companies
products.problem: Startup and winterization work spans access, controller state, backflow or supply status, zone checks, repairs, and customer decisions across many properties.
products.valueProposition: Turns irrigation startup and winterization tracking into a visible operating queue so every seasonal transition is completed, exceptioned, or rescheduled with property-specific evidence.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets irrigation startup and winterization tracking software, irrigation startup and winterization tracking tracker, irrigation startup and winterization tracking template, and irrigation startup and winterization tracking checklist searches.
